Text: Friendly & helpful veterinarian! Our dog Wilson was comfortable and unafraid! Highly recommend.
Author: Claudia + Wilson

Text: I cannot say enough about the people here. Dr. Strohmeyer and Dr. Reina are amazing, and so is the staff! They explain everything so well, and always make sure our girl is not stressed. Thank you for taking such good care of our sweet Kiki.
Author: Victoria Kidder

Text: Kari & Stephanie are both amazing veterinarians. They have taken great care of my cats. The front desk staff are all very friendly and welcoming. Everyone does a great job.
Author: Taylor Johnson

Text: Knowledgeable veterinarian. Excellent and caring staff was given to our furbaby. Easy to make appointments and has no long wait time. We have pet insurance, and the staff responded with the completed paperwork ready in a reasonably timely manner for us to submit a claim.
Author: June Turner

Text: Dr. Reina helped educate us on our new breed, as well as the illnesses that came with her from another state. She also helped me through the frustration that came with adding a new family member, and how best to transition the puppy in with our older dog. My dogs are my babies and I wouldn't trust them with any other vet in the valley. Pearl and Dodger are in great hands when they visit Dr. Reina!
Author: Lindsay Hetherington

Text: Wow! We needed care for our Dutch rabbit and met Dr. Reina. She was warm, knowledgeable and answered all our questions in an approachable way. We are thrilled to have found our local vet!
Author: C. Jones
